providers.name: Luma Labs
providers.tagline: Dream Machine — cinematic image-to-video and text-to-video
workflow: Generate key still frames in Flux or Nano Banana Pro.
Use start frame + end frame in Luma for controlled motion between beats.
Iterate on camera path, duration, and aspect ratio per platform cut.
providers.promptTips: Describe camera move, lens, lighting, and subject continuity. Pair with explicit start/end stills for best control.

providers.name: Runway
providers.tagline: Gen-3 / Gen-4 Alpha — premium motion and inpainting
workflow: Import start frame or short plate.
Apply motion brush to subject vs background separately.
Extend clips to hit storyboard duration targets.
providers.promptTips: Keep prompts short and motion-focused. Use negative space for typography overlays in post.

providers.name: Kling
providers.tagline: Kling AI — long clips, strong human motion
workflow: Generate 5–10s plates per storyboard beat.
Use reference images for wardrobe and set continuity.
Cut down in Opus Clips or NLE for platform versions.
providers.promptTips: Specify wardrobe, time of day, and emotional beat. Reference prior frame for continuity.

providers.name: SeaDance
providers.tagline: ByteDance SeaDance — rhythmic motion and performance
workflow: Lock music bed or click track first.
Generate performance plates on beat markers.
Cut to Opus-style shorts with caption overlays.
providers.promptTips: Mention tempo, choreography style, and camera distance (wide vs close).

providers.name: Cling
providers.tagline: Cling Video — character-consistent motion from stills
workflow: Approve hero still in Flux or Nano Banana Pro.
Animate with Cling using minimal camera change for loops.
Export platform loops for website hero and paid social.
providers.promptTips: Freeze wardrobe and hairstyle in the still; prompt only motion and expression changes.

providers.name: Flux
providers.tagline: Black Forest Labs Flux — photoreal key art and start/end frames
workflow: Generate scene stills per storyboard beat.
Upscale and retouch in Photoshop if needed.
Feed approved stills to Luma, Runway, Kling, or Cling for motion.
providers.promptTips: Use master image prompt + negative prompt from Goldie. Specify lens, film stock, and lighting direction.

providers.name: Nano Banana Pro
providers.tagline: 4K frame lab for start/end plates and macro product detail
workflow: Generate macro and product stills for hook frames.
Use as first/last frame for Luma or Runway motion.
Pull stills into Opus Clips as thumbnail sources.
providers.promptTips: Request shallow depth of field, hard rim light, and material-specific texture language.

providers.name: Higgsfield
providers.tagline: Higgsfield plug-ins — themed scene and campaign packs
workflow: Map Goldie storyboard beats to Higgsfield plug-in themes.
Generate variations per platform ratio.
Select finals and hand off to NLE or Opus Clips.
providers.promptTips: Lead with brand palette, campaign angle, and plug-in theme name.

providers.name: Opus Clips
providers.tagline: Long-form to viral shorts with AI captions
workflow: Upload source long-form video or Goldie rough assembly.
Select clip count, duration targets, and caption style.
Review AI-suggested hooks; export vertical cuts with burned-in captions.
providers.promptTips: Feed Goldie-generated hook lines and CTA text as caption guidance where supported.
